Good place
Nov 2025 • Family
Nice place to enjoy fresh sushi.

The restaurant is very close to Train Street and the Old Quarter — a popular and touristy area.

The space itself is quite small, with only a few tables. The service is a bit slow, but the food is nicely presented.

I would recommend that the owners pay more attention to cleanliness inside (though I understand this is quite common in Vietnam).

As for the food, we ordered sashimi and received a beautifully presented dish, and my salad was fresh and delicious.

Small in Space, Big in Taste & Value
Oct 2025 • Friends
This sushi house if very small, with just a few tables inside & out. It is also not fancy, & you pay at the counter. The kitchen is 2 stories above. & the food is delivered via pulleys and in a picnic basket outside. 
The prices are reasonable, the selection is large, & the sushi is fresh & tasty. Beer & wine are also available. 
Location is in the outskirts of the Old Quarter.

Limited availability
Sep 2025 • Family
We visited SushiLAB Restaurant twice because of its excellent reviews. Before our visit, we checked the website, which offered a wide selection of dishes, all of which were available to order. However, when we arrived at the restaurant, most of the tuna dishes were unavailable—we were told that they had almost run out of tuna. Since we would have liked to eat tuna, we left the restaurant without dinner. When we went back five days later, we experienced the exact same situation: the same dishes were still unavailable. We understand that this situation can happen once, but twice? We are disappointed.

Largely Disappointing
Dec 2024 • Couples
Nice setting and good service, but i thought the sushi was a bit cheapened, in that the quantity of fish within the roll, ect, was fairly mean and bulked up by the addition of lettuce and cheese.
I've eaten a lot of sushi in numerous countries and unfortunately consider this to simply not be authentic.
Maybe it's a cultural things, however I thought that what little fish was present was totally overpowered by the addition of cheap cheeses and strong sauces.
I have been looking forward to this dining experience for weeks, and I leave mostly disappointed.
I try somewhere else next time, I think.
